The branded-type design is PROVEN, not assumed: zod 4.4.3 defines `$brand` as a required unique-symbol property, and the compiler produced exactly the intended error - 'Type string is not assignable to type string & $brand<"DateOnly">' - at the Week call sites into the DateColumnKey-pinned cross-row commit. FR-1's compile-time guarantee is real.

TWO PLAN GAPS were found during execution and added as packets after allowlist validation: tp_cg_004b (math/drag-column.ts) and tp_cg_004c (math/cross-row.drag.ts). Both return DayColumnCache values that feed dayDate, so without them the assignment widens to 'string | TColumnKey' and fails. THREE more files not in the original plan also needed edits and were done: tp_cg_011b (Day all-day.commit), tp_cg_016b and tp_cg_016c (the two Week per-interaction modules).

The source showed it actually lives in the geometry caches - week-layout.cache.ts line 55 'visibleDates: sources.visibleDays'. Branding there is a one-line change that threads DateColumnKey through all of Week WITHOUT touching the 795-line adapter, which is strictly better for a no-behavior-change refactor. Step 3 (geometry) was therefore pulled ahead of the step-1 adapter packets.

SCOPE CONFIRMED SAFE: DayInteractionCoordinator.tsx imports only GridLayoutCacheSources, which was deliberately left non-generic, so Gate 2's cut of FR-6 holds - neither coordinator .tsx has been touched.

Policy flash-agsdk-only routes ALL phases to the antigravity-worker adapter, which is NOT gated by the write-contract hook.
